articles.summary: BitGo Holdings, Inc. (“BitGo”) (NYSE: BTGO) and OKX today announced the international expansion of their Off-Exchange Settlement integration, enabling eligible institutions outside the U.S. to access OKX’s liquidity while supported assets remain in segregated, regulated custody with BitGo Singapore Pte. Ltd. (“BitGo Singapore”). The expansion builds on the relationship established earlier this year, when OKX joined BitGo’s Go Network for U.S. institutions. Together, the integrations give eligible institutions in the U.S. and international markets a consistent model for separating custody, execution and settlement, while maintaining access to OKX’s global liquidity and trading infrastructure. “We believe institutions are increasingly looking to separate where they trade from where they hold their assets,” said Mike Belshe, CEO and Co-founder of BitGo. “That separation is becoming an important part of how institutions manage counterparty risk and evaluate exchange relationships.
articles.title: OKX and BitGo Expand Off-Exchange Settlement Infrastructure to Institutions Globally
